Biometric

You are a small mechanical bug in a drowned pump yard. Fifteen batteries lie in the rain. Collect them all as fast as you can.

Every dash burns one charge. A small cell gives 3, a big red battery 9. Dash straight through a spider to kill it.

Spiders crawl out of the vents. Alone they are cowards; two together crackle with an arc and lunge. Ten hits and you are done.

Press a move key or tap to start.
